deroling.title: De-roling & Grounding Ceremony
deroling.intro: A crucial concluding ritual to release emotional projections from the figures and return safely to present reality.
deroling.step1: 1. Click each figure on the table, acknowledging 'This was only a symbolic tool, not the actual person', returning it to the waiting zone.
deroling.step2: 2. Take three deep, grounding breaths and feel the solid ground beneath your feet.
deroling.step3: 3. Name three physical objects you see in your current room.
deroling.step4: 4. Formulate the smallest concrete commitment or action step for tomorrow.
